robots.name: [EDIT: 2025 robot name]
robots.description: Our REEFSCAPE robot placed PVC "coral" on the reef and handled algae on the way to a 5–4–0 record at the East Bay Regional — the team's first winning qualification record since 2018.

robots.name: [EDIT: 2024 robot name]
robots.description: Built to shoot foam "notes" into the speaker and amp, this robot went 6–6–0 at the Sacramento Regional, with a four-match win streak that included an alliance with 1678 Citrus Circuits.

robots.name: Leonidas
robots.description: Leonidas — the name our robots carried from 2015 through 2023, after the Spartan king — reached the semifinals three years running. The 2018 edition was a first-round pick and helped post a 407-point quarterfinal, the highest score in team history.

specs.label: Sponsors
specs.value: Nvidia & De La Salle High School

robots.name: Sparticus
robots.description: One of the team's first named robots, from the early Silicon Valley Regional years. Sparticus raced laps and moved 40-inch trackballs in our only two-regional season to include a trip to San Diego.

specs.label: Sponsors
specs.value: De La Salle High School, AT&T West
